text: What is the maximum recommended duration for a 1-month Sprint Review meeting?
explanation: The Sprint Review is timeboxed to a maximum of 4 hours for a one-month Sprint. For shorter Sprints, it is usually shorter.

options.explanation_why_incorrect: 2 hours is the standard for Sprint Retrospective on 1-month Sprints.
8 hours is the maximum timebox for Sprint Planning on 1-month Sprints.
Too short for a comprehensive Sprint Review.

text: True or False: The Scrum Master can cancel a Sprint if the Sprint Goal becomes obsolete.
explanation: Only the Product Owner has the authority to cancel the Sprint.

options.explanation_why_incorrect: Only the Product Owner can cancel a Sprint.
